tasks.short: Receive, check, record and authorize disbursement requests under financial policies.

steps.what: Receive requests and supporting documents from budget owners.
Check supporting documents against request details and existing records.

loop.input: Supporting documents without usable structured fields.
loop.output: Proposed invoice fields with page references and missing-field flags.
loop.check: Validate schema, totals, duplicate identifiers and matches to purchase orders; review uncertain fields.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair attempt per document; unresolved fields return to the clerk.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use structured imports first. Variable document layouts need bounded extraction when imports are unavailable.

steps.what: Enter checked request details into the financial approval record.
Check approval limits, budget availability and required separation of duties.
Resolve missing evidence and policy exceptions with the budget owner.
Authorize or reject the request within delegated financial limits.
Notify the requester and pass authorized requests to payment processing.

tasks.design: Configure intake, policy checks, routing and decision notices in the {WORKFLOW} and {ERP}, reusing {PROCUREMENT} records. A bounded extractor proposes fields from unsupported documents; validated intake removes duplicate entry. The finance manager approves authorization, while payment release remains a separate downstream action in the {BANK}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests arrived through different channels, approval limits were inconsistently maintained, and document handling made integration costly.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approval configuration handles much of the task. AI-assisted coding can reduce the effort of building adapters and validation; bounded extraction covers remaining document formats.
tasks.still_hard: Urgent exceptions, disputed obligations, changed supplier bank details and conflicting delegation rules require reliable controls and human investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a formally compliant request still lacks a sound business purpose or credible evidence.

ambition.what: Daily review of urgent disbursement exceptions before payment cutoffs

tasks.altitude: The treasurer spends less time assembling requests and more time resolving exceptions before payment cutoffs. Existing authorization limits remain; wider decision rights require explicit delegation.

reach.task: Prepare payment batches from authorized disbursements.
reach.learn: Payment cutoffs, duplicate-payment controls and separation between request approval and bank release.
Evidence preservation and independent verification of changed payment details.

evidence.claim: Structured disbursement intake, policy checks and approval routing can primarily use existing configuration.
Bounded extraction can propose document fields, with deterministic validation and exception review.

assumptions: The company uses the {ERP} for financial records and has documented approval limits.
Some requests arrive through the {EMAIL}; direct structured intake should replace that route where practical.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates, not measured savings.
Build ranges cover one entity and a limited set of request types.
Access estimates include GDPR review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which approval and intake features are already licensed and configured?
What proportion of requests lacks structured supporting data?
Who may authorize requests, and which requests require additional approval?
Which supplier verification controls and audit logs already exist?
research_questions: Can existing approval configuration handle the required delegation and exception paths?
How accurately can unsupported document fields be extracted on representative samples?
Which validation failures should block authorization rather than merely flag review?
new_work: Resolve blocked requests and investigate suspicious evidence.
Maintain approval limits and document mappings.
Monitor failed imports, routing errors and audit-log completeness.

tasks.short: Advise management on financial objectives, policies and proposed actions.

steps.what: Gather financial results, cash outlook and management questions.
Calculate financial scenarios and sensitivities for proposed objectives.
Assess tradeoffs and select recommendations for management.
Write an advice paper explaining options, assumptions and consequences.

loop.input: Selected recommendations, approved scenario outputs and explicit assumptions.
loop.output: Draft advice paper with references to scenario rows and stated uncertainties.
loop.check: Recalculate numerical claims, verify references and have the treasurer review reasoning.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per paper; unsupported claims are removed or returned to the treasurer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables and standard sections use templates. Explaining changing tradeoffs in readable prose needs a bounded drafting step.

steps.what: Discuss recommendations and decide financial objectives or policy changes.
Record decisions, owners and follow-up dates.

tasks.design: A governed baseline from the {ERP}, {BANK} and {BI} feeds deterministic scenario calculations on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded loop drafts the advice paper in the {DOCS}, using only selected recommendations and checked figures. Management discusses and approves changes; the {PROJECT} records decisions and follow-up dates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scenario work depended on individual workbooks, inconsistent assumptions and manually assembled advice papers.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable calculations and source-linked templates are straightforward to build. Bounded drafting can shorten preparation without taking over management advice.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing objectives depends on uncertain demand, financing conditions, management priorities and appetite for risk.
tasks.human_edge: Frame uncomfortable tradeoffs clearly and understand which commitments management can sustain.

ambition.what: Monthly review of liquidity versus growth tradeoffs

tasks.altitude: The treasurer can bring refreshed options to management more often and spend more time testing assumptions with decision makers. Recommendation rights remain; management retains authority over objectives and policy.

reach.task: Evaluate the financial consequences of capital investment proposals.
reach.learn: Discounted cash flow, sensitivity analysis and the limits of project assumptions.

reach.task: Stress-test liquidity under adverse operating conditions.
reach.learn: Risk limits, correlated shocks and practical contingency actions.

evidence.claim: Deterministic scenario calculations can separate numerical preparation from management judgement.
Nomentia documents cash forecasting from bank and financial data with forecast-versus-actual comparisons.
Source-linked drafting can assist advice preparation; the digest does not establish reliable autonomous financial advice.

assumptions: Management advice uses agreed financial definitions and a recurring forecast baseline.
Scenario assumptions remain explicit human inputs.
Preparation is more changeable than the advisory conversation, despite low drudgery in the priors.
Time shares, remaining percentages and build ranges are estimates.
Access work includes GDPR review where personal data enters the baseline and consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which financial objectives and decision cadence does management use?
How consistent are current scenario formulas and assumptions?
Who can approve policy changes and financing commitments?
Which data may be shared across departments?
research_questions: Which scenarios can use a common calculation engine without losing material business differences?
Does source-linked drafting reduce review time on actual advice papers?
Which forecast errors most often change management decisions?
new_work: Maintain scenario definitions and source mappings.
Review draft reasoning and numerical references.
Investigate stale baselines and failed data refreshes.

tasks.short: Direct financial planning, budgets, procurement commitments and corporate liquidity activities.

steps.what: Set planning deadlines, assumptions, financial limits and responsibilities.
Gather actual spending, open commitments, balances and expected cash movements.
Submit departmental forecasts and proposed spending with assumptions.
Consolidate submissions and calculate budget, cash and commitment scenarios.
Challenge assumptions and resolve competing departmental requests.
Approve resource allocations, financial limits and the funding approach.
Publish approved budgets, responsibilities and control limits.
Approve material procurement commitments within delegated limits.
Authorize funding or short-term investment instructions under the treasury mandate.

tasks.design: Configure planning submissions and approvals in the {WORKFLOW}, using governed feeds from the {ERP}, {PROCUREMENT} and {BANK}. Deterministic consolidation and scenario calculations feed the {BI}; approved limits return to the operational systems. Procurement approvals and external treasury instructions retain their own action gates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Departmental workbooks had different assumptions and versions, while commitments and cash positions sat in separate systems.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured forms and deterministic calculations can replace consolidation work. AI-assisted coding reduces adapter and dashboard development effort without resolving planning judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating priorities, predicting departmental needs and selecting funding actions remain difficult. Financing terms and bank authorization arrangements constrain integration.
tasks.human_edge: Balance financial resilience against operational needs and secure realistic commitments from budget owners.

ambition.what: Weekly reallocation review for uncommitted discretionary spending

tasks.altitude: The treasurer spends less time chasing versions and more time challenging spending and liquidity assumptions. A delegated reallocation mandate could support weekly decisions; bank and investment authority remains explicitly limited.

reach.task: Assess departmental forecasts against spending drivers.
reach.learn: Driver-based budgeting and how operational assumptions affect timing.

reach.task: Monitor liquidity limits and financing exposures.
reach.learn: Treasury mandates, counterparty limits and stress scenarios.

reach.task: Estimate costs for proposed capital projects.
reach.learn: Estimate uncertainty, contingency allowances and commitment timing.

evidence.claim: Structured submissions, consolidation and limit publication are suitable for configuration and deterministic code.
Nomentia documents cash forecasts using bank and financial data and comparisons with actual results.
The digest identifies no need for an autonomous agent in finance and treasury task preparation.

assumptions: The job concerns corporate finance, procurement oversight and liquidity rather than managing an investment fund.
Some departmental submissions still use the {SPREADSHEET}, even though accounting records reside in the {ERP}.
The company has agreed budget dimensions, delegation limits and a treasury mandate.
Time shares and remaining percentages describe an illustrative planning cycle, including adjacent-role contributions.
Build ranges assume several departments and one primary financial entity.
Access work includes GDPR review and consultation where planning changes affect employee data or national rules require it.
unknowns: Does the existing planning system already support structured submissions and consolidation?
How many entities, currencies and budget dimensions must be covered?
Which procurement and treasury actions fall within this person's mandate?
Do financing agreements impose additional approval or reporting requirements?
research_questions: Can existing planning configuration replace workbook exchange before custom development?
Which commitment and cash feeds are timely enough for weekly reallocation decisions?
Which scenario outputs can be reconciled directly to approved financial baselines?
new_work: Maintain planning dimensions, assumptions and delegation limits.
Resolve rejected submissions and data mapping exceptions.
Monitor forecast accuracy and stale commitments.
Review procurement and treasury action proposals.
Reconcile published limits across connected systems.

tasks.short: Direct preparation of financial statements, forecasts, budgets and required financial reports.

steps.what: Set reporting deadlines and request outstanding financial inputs.
Extract ledger balances, supporting schedules and bank data.
Reconcile balances and identify missing entries or unexplained differences.
Resolve material exceptions and approve estimates or adjusting entries.
Build statement tables, forecast schedules, budget comparisons and required report layouts.
Write commentary, accounting notes and explanations of material variances.

loop.input: Checked report tables, approved accounting conclusions and supplied variance explanations.
loop.output: Draft commentary and notes linked to table rows and supporting records.
loop.check: Validate every numerical reference; reject unsupported causes and review accounting language.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair attempt per section; unresolved explanations return to the analyst.
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed disclosures use templates. Material variance explanations change each period and require bounded prose drafting.

steps.what: Review material disclosures and certify the completed report pack.
Distribute approved reports to authorized internal recipients.
Submit required reports and retain filing acknowledgements.

tasks.design: Scheduled feeds from the {ERP} and {BANK} populate a governed dataset on the {DATA_PLATFORM}, where deterministic reconciliation and report generators produce checked tables. A bounded loop drafts commentary in the {DOCS}, while accounting adjustments and certification retain human approval. The {WORKFLOW} distributes approved internal reports and prepares supported {GOV_PORTAL} submissions for an authorized filing officer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report preparation depended on workbook mappings, repeated exports and manually updated layouts. Accounting judgements and changing filing requirements prevented complete automation.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic mappings, reconciliation tests and report templates can be built and maintained more cheaply. Bounded drafting can reuse checked figures and approved explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Accounting estimates, materiality, consolidation differences and changing statutory formats remain demanding. Some filing routes lack supported interfaces.
tasks.human_edge: Identify misleading presentation, challenge estimates and take responsibility for material accounting conclusions.

ambition.what: Mid-month management financial pack with explicit provisional figures

tasks.altitude: The controller spends less time formatting reports and more time investigating material differences and explaining financial performance. Certification and adjustment authority remain unchanged; a provisional reporting service needs management agreement.

reach.task: Evaluate accounting estimates and supporting evidence.
reach.learn: Materiality, audit trails and evidence standards for adjusting entries.

reach.task: Maintain financial measures and report datasets.
reach.learn: Ledger reconciliation, reporting definitions and dataset version control.

reach.task: Prepare statutory financial filings from approved records.
reach.learn: Filing schemas, reporting deadlines and acknowledgement handling.

evidence.claim: Structured financial tables, reconciliations and report layouts can use deterministic generators.
Accounting judgement and certification remain human work even when report assembly is automated.
Bounded commentary drafting should use checked figures and supplied explanations rather than infer unsupported causes.

assumptions: The representative cycle combines internal reporting with occasional statutory submissions; individual cycles differ.
Approved budgets and cash forecasts come from the connected planning and treasury workflows.
Reconciliation rules cover known matching cases; unresolved differences remain visible.
Automated filing applies only where a supported interface or accepted file format exists.
Time shares, remaining percentages and build ranges are estimates for a limited report set.
EU GDPR and EU AI Act applicability must be assessed for the actual use; ordinary financial reporting is not assumed to be employment scoring.
Access ranges include employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which accounting framework, entities and consolidation requirements apply?
Which report templates and filing formats are mandatory?
Who approves estimates, certifies reports and authorizes submissions?
Which reconciliation rules and report generators already exist?
Which employee-level data appear in reports and who may access them?
research_questions: Can generated tables reproduce approved reports and reconcile to source balances?
Which material disclosures require fresh human analysis each period?
Which filing routes support validated file submission and retrievable acknowledgements?
Can provisional reports clearly distinguish posted figures from estimates?
new_work: Maintain report mappings, reconciliation rules and filing schemas.
Review unsupported commentary and unresolved differences.
Monitor data refreshes and report version consistency.
Verify filing acknowledgements and handle rejected submissions.
Retain evidence connecting approved reports to their source records.

role.altitude: The week shifts from gathering, rekeying and formatting toward liquidity choices, exception resolution and accounting judgement. Financial authority remains within existing mandates unless management explicitly delegates more.
reach: Work with Budget Analysts on driver-based forecasts and practical reallocation options.
Work with Financial Risk Specialists on liquidity stress tests and contingency actions.
Work with Accountants and Auditors on estimates, reconciliations and evidence.
Work with Business Intelligence Analysts on shared financial definitions and reliable datasets.
skills_to_grow: Translate financial policies into testable rules and approval paths.
Specify source mappings and reconcile generated outputs.
Design scenarios with explicit assumptions and uncertainty.
Explain financial tradeoffs and negotiate realistic commitments.
role.ambitious_version: Offer a connected financial decision service: weekly discretionary-spending reviews, monthly liquidity-versus-growth advice and a provisional mid-month management pack. Reuse the same governed financial baseline while keeping accounting certification and external financial actions under explicit human authority.
